purpose: Test the exact joint interface suggested by the strongest real near-hit: reflection, a Loeb rule arising from quotation, and internal certification of reflection at the same claimed layer.

source_basis.kind: generic conditional target plus fixed real consumer audit

answer_visibility.limitation: The designer knew the standard Loeb shape; novelty and HoTT correspondence are not established.

input.type_ref: Box : Set→Set, reflect : Box A→A, lob : Box(Box A→A)→Box A, certify : Box(Box A→A)
input.available_information: all three operations are hypotheses of the conditional target; no fixed source is assumed to supply them

environment.reality_model: actual systems separate checking, quotation, trust base and meta-level
environment.theory_model: one same-layer interface combines reflection, Loeb closure and internally certified reflection

observation.value: whether the joint interface collapses at bottom
observation.trace: certify reflection at bottom, apply Loeb, reflect boxed bottom

time_structure.reality: verification responsibility is staged across object, checker and trust base
time_structure.theory: the joint interface closes those dependencies in one layer
time_structure.temporal_order: the certificate becomes input to the same reliability mechanism

completion.criterion_ref: derive bottom only from the exact three-interface conjunction

quantifiers.instances: all Box : Set→Set satisfying the three supplied operations

allowed_resources: the three declared interface hypotheses and bottom
prohibited_extra_information: no assertion that HoTT, Agda or MetaRocq supplies the conjunction; no Goedel/Loeb originality claim
assumptions: reflect, lob and certify have the exact target types
consumer qualification is independent and may return zero hits
obligations: all three rules must occur in the witness
removing certify_reflection must remove every goal witness
native negative control must reject reflection plus Loeb without certification
the source audit must decide whether any fixed HoTT consumer supplies the conjunction

known_positive_controls.description: given checking, bounded search and finite truth remain independently available

known_negative_controls.description: reflection plus the Loeb rule lacks a boxed reflection premise

correspondence.original_activity: a theory certifies the reliability of its own proof mechanism
theoryization_steps: obtain Loeb closure from quotation/diagonal structure
changed_fields: the actual source systems do not currently supply this joint same-layer package
correspondence.observation_justification: the three assumptions and consumer criteria were frozen before search
correspondence.reality_bridge_detail: The native target checks the conditional conjunction. Only the fixed-source Q1-Q6 audit can attach it to a real system.
open_obligations: keep ERCF-3 gated unless one source passes Q1-Q6
do not call the generic boundary an HoTT bug
